about: Answer key for lost_values (step 3A, PR 10c), written by the controller by reading before the code. SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: every amount, date and name is invented and no line is copied from a retained draft. A draft is front + title + head + body + tail, where `previous` and `new` are the two bodies and `previous_front`, `previous_title`, `new_front`, `new_title` are empty unless a case gives them. The head is five lines, so with no front and no title the first line of a body is line 6. `named` lists the findings of the previous draft as [check, severity, line, quoted]; `reason` maps a finding's position to its reason (any other finding has the reason `Synthetic reason.`). Only a finding's line and quoted text are read, so its check id need not be the check that would make it. `lost` is the whole expected result in order, each row [line, value, label].
